title: HR Administrator
description:
HR ADMINISTRATOR

Location: Hull, DN14 (Driver required due to location), 4 days in office, one day home working.

Hours: 09:00 - 17:00.

Salary: 15.40 per hour.

Contract: Temporary to Permanent (initially until end of 2026, with potential extension)

Start Date: ASAP, subject to a 2 stage interview process.

About the Role

Our Client is seeking a highly organised and proactive HR Administrator to join its HR team, supporting the Services Function and wider Operations and Manufacturing business areas.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HR Administrator or HR Assistant looking to broaden their exposure across the full employee lifecycle while gaining valuable experience in Employee Relations, HR systems, and project work.

Key Responsibilities
HR Administration
- Provide comprehensive HR administrative support across the employee lifecycle.
- Manage onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth employee experience.
- Prepare and maintain employee documentation, contracts, letters, and records.
- Administer reward and benefits processes.
- Ensure all employee records are accurate, compliant, and up to date.

HR Systems & Data Management
- Maintain and update HR systems, with a strong focus on data accuracy.
- Produce HR reports and support regular HR metrics reporting.
- Support data audits and identify discrepancies where required.
- Manage employee information within Workday and other HR systems.

Compliance & Governance
- Handle Subject Access Requests (SARs) in line with GDPR requirements.
- Ensure HR processes remain compliant with company policies and employment legislation.
- Maintain confidentiality when dealing with sensitive employee information.

Projects & Training
- Support HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Assist with training administration and coordination activities.
- Contribute to process improvements and efficiency enhancements within the HR function.

Person Specification
Essential Experience
- Must have experience using 'WorkDay'. Please do not apply if you havent yet used this system.
- Previous experience in an HR Assistant, HR Administrator, or similar HR support role.
- Strong understanding of the employee lifecycle.
- Experience managing HR data and maintaining HR systems.
- Excellent administration and organisational skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage competing priorities independently.
- Experience working within a fast-paced operational environment.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

Technical Skills
- Microsoft 365 Suite.
- Excel (including reporting and data management).
- Adobe.
- HR Information Systems (HRIS).
- Experience using Workday is a must.

Personal Attributes
- Proactive and self-motivated.
- Process-driven and methodical.
- Strong analytical and numerical capability.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Able to use initiative and work with minimal supervision.
- Team-oriented with a flexible and supportive approach.

Qualifications
- No formal HR qualification required.

Perks
- Free Canteen!

Why Join?
- Gain exposure across the full employee lifecycle.
- Work with leading HR technology, including Workday.
- Join a collaborative HR team supporting multiple business functions.
- Potential for contract extension and longer-term opportunities.
- Varied and fast-paced environment with excellent learning and development exposure.

We can't wait to meet you!

How to Apply:

Please send your up to date CV in today with an up to date contact number and email.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Quotations & Estimating Coordinator
description:
Are you an experienced Quotations Coordinator, Estimator, Costing Coordinator or Commercial Coordinator looking for your next opportunity within a manufacturing business in the Hull area?

Do you enjoy working with detailed information, building accurate quotations and making sure every element of a customer requirement has been properly costed?

If so, this Quotations & Estimating Coordinator job in Hull could be a really good next step.

Our client is an established manufacturing business with a strong reputation for producing bespoke solutions for its customers. Due to a recent change within the team, they are now looking for a Quotations & Estimating Coordinator to join their Commercial department.

You ll be working closely with Account Management, Commercial and operational teams, turning customer requirements into accurate, competitive quotations. It s a role that needs someone who enjoys detail, understands how costs come together and can manage a busy workload without losing accuracy.

What the Quotations & Estimating Coordinator job involves

You ll be responsible for producing accurate and timely customer quotations, taking into account all of the different elements required to deliver each project.
- Producing accurate and commercially competitive quotations.
- Reviewing customer briefs and information supplied by the Account Management team.
- Calculating costs across areas such as materials, design work, labour, production time and other associated costs.
- Creating bespoke quotations based on individual customer requirements.
- Prioritising estimates according to customer needs and commercial deadlines.
- Supporting Account Management and Business Development with quotations for both new and existing customers.
- Liaising with suppliers, customers and colleagues across the wider business where further information is required.
- Maintaining accurate information within the company s CRM and estimating systems.
- Helping to ensure consistency across pricing and estimating processes.

The role plays an important part in supporting both existing customers and new business opportunities.

Skills required

We re looking for someone who is naturally organised, enjoys working with numbers and detailed information, and takes real pride in accuracy.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within estimating, quotations, costing, pricing, commercial coordination or a similar role.
- Experience within manufacturing, print, packaging, engineering or another production environment would be advantageous.
- Strong numerical skills and confidence working with detailed cost information.
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
- Strong data processing and analytical skills.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Strong communication skills and confidence liaising with customers, suppliers and internal departments.
- A structured and process-driven approach.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- Experience using CRM or estimating software would be beneficial.
- A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues across the team.

We are particularly looking for someone who is accurate, adaptable, able to work under pressure and comfortable managing changing priorities.

You may currently be working as a Quotations Coordinator, Estimator, Cost Estimator, Manufacturing Estimator, Commercial Coordinator, Pricing Coordinator, Costing Coordinator, Sales Estimator or Commercial Estimator and be looking for your next opportunity in the Hull area.

Other information
- Hours: 9.00am 5.30pm
- 24 days holiday plus bank holidays, with the opportunity to buy up to five additional days.
- Auto-enrolment pension.
- Regular company events and social activities throughout the year.
- Free on-site parking.
- Christmas Eve and New Year s Eve early finish, subject to business requirements.
- Opportunity to join an established manufacturing business with a strong emphasis on integrity, teamwork and sustainability.

title: Part Time Sales Administrator
description:
We are looking for a highly organised and customer-focused Part Time Sales Administrator to join our team temporary-to-permanent basis and provide essential support across the sales function. This is a varied and fast-paced role, responsible for ensuring customer orders, enquiries and sales opportunities are managed accurately and efficiently, while maintaining high-quality CRM and sales data. Working closely with sales, operations, logistics and finance, you will play a key role in delivering an excellent customer experience, supporting the smooth progression of orders and helping the wider team achieve its commercial objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring all information is recorded correctly.
- Prepare and issue quotations, sales orders, and other sales documentation.
- Manage the HubSpot CRM, including deal creation, uploads, allocation, maintenance, and ensuring customer records remain accurate and up to date.
- Allocate inbound enquiries and sales opportunities to the appropriate sales representatives in accordance with company processes.
- Maintain customer records, pricing information, contacts, and sales data across company systems.
- Monitor sales pipelines and support the sales team by ensuring CRM data is accurate, complete, and up to date.
- Act as a primary point of contact for customer enquiries, providing timely and professional support.
- Liaise with operations, logistics, finance, and the sales team to ensure the smooth progression of customer orders and projects.
- Monitor order progress and communicate updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
- Identify and resolve customer or operational issues, escalating where appropriate.
- Produce routine sales reports and CRM data to support management reporting and business performance.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, ISO9001 procedures, and service standards.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales administration processes, CRM data quality, and customer experience.
- Undertake any other reasonable duties requested by the Business Operations Manager or Executive Directors.

KEY ATTRIBUTES
- Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Customer-focused with a proactive approach to problem solving.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
- Strong administrative and data management skills.
- Experience using CRM systems, preferably HubSpot.
- Competent in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
- Reliable, professional, and committed to delivering a high standard of work.
- Able to work collaboratively across multiple departments.

title: Reigonal Network Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
description:
Reigonal Network Coordinator (Maternity Cover)

Location: Hull (on-site)

Salary: Starting salary £26,234 per annum

Vacancy Type: 1 x 6 month and 1 x 10 month maternity cover positions available

Who we are

Vizion Network is a forward-thinking organisation dedicated to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Located in Hull and Wellingborough, we pride ourselves on our commitment to employee development, wellbeing, and innovation.
Our mission is to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent by fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered.
We champion equity, recognising that our strength lies in the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and talents of our people.
Through transparent practices, continuous development, and meaningful engagement, we strive to create an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

Purpose

The Regional Network Coordinator is responsible for allocation/reallocation and progression of vehicle repairs within a specific geographical region from initial contact, to repair handover and aftercare as required, keeping in close contact with all key stakeholders throughout the repair process to ensure all SLAs are maintained and adhered to. Working within a regional team, you will build effective partnerships with repairers, leveraging those relationships to improve and maintain the highest level service for the Company's customers and clients.

Role Profile
- Ensure that you are kept fully up to date with Insurer/Client SLAs and understand the KPI's the repairers are to adhere as a Vizion Member
- Efficiently and accurately process and allocate repair notifications within SLA using the in-house management system.
- Analyse damage, incident circumstances, and vehicle specifications to assign repairs to appropriate supplier or escalate to the Fast Track Total Loss Team when needed.
- Resolve allocation delays and courtesy car related issues.
- Ensure all customers are kept adequately updated where there is a reallocation delay.
- Collaborate with the Regional Network Controller to place challenging or repeatedly rejected cases with a suitable supplier.
- Work to improve the first-time acceptance ratio and reduce multiple rejections in collaboration with the Regional Network Controller.
- Provide investigative feedback on repairs to the senior management team and clients as necessary.
- Progress customer claims within the company's management system meeting internally agreed SLA's.
- Manage daily tasks driven by the system as well as other ad hoc tasks assigned within agreed SLA's.
- Monitor and manage supplier performance metrics, breaches, and cancellations on a day-to-day basis.
- Build and nurture relationships within the repair network to ensure seamless customer repairs.
- Act as a point of contact for repair network members, clients, customers, and team member, providing progress updates as needed.
- Handle incoming calls and emails and act promptly, and professionally, addressing inquiries and actions efficiently.
- Monitor personal and general inboxes and promptly handle emails.
- Record all client issues and feedback to the Line Manager and the Management Team.
- Assist with requested for departmental, regional or client analysis and management.

Person Specification

Experience working within the Repair/Insurance industry is desirable.

Prior experience within customer service with exposure to effective communication with clients/Suppliers/customers is essential

First class communication skills, including the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.

Exceptional attention to detail for accurate claim processing and data management.

Relationship building skills to nurture repair network connections and liaise effectively various stakeholders.

Adaptability and flexibility to work within a dynamic, fast paced environment.

Ability to work to agreed deadlines, targets and objectives.

Collaborative team player with a cooperative and supportive approach to achieve shared goals.

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage and prioritise tasks efficiently.

Problem solving abilities, particularly in resolving allocation issues, and progression queries.

Good decision maker

Customer centric mindset with a commitment to providing a first-class service to customers and repairers, maintaining a positive business image.

Proficient in using in house management systems.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office Packages, including Power Bi.

What we offer

37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday plus 1 in 6 Saturdays (8.30am - 12.30pm)

Employee health and benefits scheme, including anonymous counselling service, 24/7 GP service, retail and gym discounts and medical cashback scheme

21 days annual leave

Additional birthday holiday

Holiday purchase scheme

Performance based salary increments

Fun Company events and functions

Free parking

Monthly free food days

Close to shops and amenities

Reward and recognition

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Vizion Network, please click apply to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

title: Account Coordinator

Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator)

Salary: 27,700 per annum

Join the Stafforce Team

At Stafforce, we're passionate about connecting people with opportunities and helping our clients build reliable, skilled workforces. We are looking for a proactive and organised Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator) to join our team, supporting a number of key client accounts across the Hull area.
This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll play a vital part in the candidate journey, from sourcing and onboarding workers through to supporting their assignments and ensuring our clients receive an outstanding service.

The Role

As a Candidate Consultant, you will work closely with our recruitment and account management teams to support the delivery of temporary workforce solutions. You will be responsible for coordinating worker onboarding, conducting inductions, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring workers are fully supported throughout their employment.
This role is primarily office-based but will involve travel to client sites across the Hull area to support onboarding and workforce activities.
The standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, however flexibility is essential as some client requirements may require early starts. You will also participate in an out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota to support our clients and workforce when needed.

Key Responsibilities
- Support recruitment activities by sourcing and coordinating suitable candidates.
- Conduct candidate registrations and onboarding processes.
- Deliver worker inductions and site briefings.
- Complete compliance checks, right-to-work verification, and employment documentation.
- Maintain accurate records using Stafforce's internal systems and databases.
- Update and manage workforce data using Microsoft Excel and other software packages.
- Build strong relationships with candidates, workers, clients, and colleagues.
- Monitor worker attendance and assist with shift coordination.
- Support workforce planning and fulfil client staffing requirements.
- Resolve worker queries and provide ongoing support throughout assignments.
- Ensure all processes are completed accurately and in line with company procedures.
- Participate in the out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota.
- Travel between client sites and offices as required.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Strong IT and administrative skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Confident using databases, software systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
- A flexible and positive approach to work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in recruitment, account coordination, administration, customer service, or a similar role.
- Experience working with temporary workers or high-volume staffing environments.
- Full UK driving licence due to travel requirements across multiple client locations in the Hull area.

What You'll Receive

In return, Stafforce offers a supportive environment where you can develop your career and make a real difference to both candidates and clients.

Benefits Include:
- Competitive salary of 27,700 per annum.
- Full training and ongoing development opportunities.
- Career progression within a well-established and growing business.
- 24/7 GP access through our employee wellbeing programme.
- Emotional wellbeing and mental health support.
- High street discounts across a wide range of retailers, restaurants, leisure providers, and services.
- Access to a supportive and collaborative team culture.

title: Team Administration Assistant

Team Administration Assistant

Company & Location: Yorkshire Accountancy, 123 Hallgate, Cottingham, HU16 4 DA
Hours: 15-20 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Salary: 13.00 per hour
Contract: Permanent, part-time
Working arrangement: Office based

About the role

We are looking for an organised, proactive and personable Team Administration Assistant to provide practical administrative support across our practice.

This is a varied administration role supporting our accounts, tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams. The purpose of the position is to take ownership of the important day-to-day administrative tasks that keep client work moving, records up to date and our teams organised.

This is not an accountancy or tax position and we are not looking for someone with an accounting background. We are looking for someone who enjoys administration, is organised, gets things done and is happy helping different members of a busy team.

Key responsibilities

The role will include:

Accounts and client administration

Logging new accounts jobs and other work onto our systems.

Keeping job records and internal systems up to date.

Chasing clients for accounting records and other information.

Chasing signed accounts and Companies House documents, including confirmation statements.

Assisting with monthly accounts and bookkeeping job updates.

Maintaining and organising electronic client records and folders.

Processing changes to client details.

Sending clients copies of documents and information when requested.

Tax and MTD administration

Assisting with administrative data entry relating to Making Tax Digital.

Logging Self Assessment checklists and information returned by clients.

Scanning and saving tax working papers and client documents.

Sending copies of SA302s, previous tax returns and other documents requested by clients.

Providing general administrative support to the tax team, particularly during busy periods.

Practice and team administration

Assisting with monthly reviews of client fixed fees.

Assisting with quarterly reviews of bookkeeping and payroll fixed fees.

Sorting, scanning and processing incoming post.

Maintaining electronic post folders and filing.

Scanning, saving and organising client documents.

Providing administrative cover when other members of the team are absent.

Helping the accounts, tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams with routine administrative tasks.

Taking ownership of agreed recurring administrative tasks and making sure they are completed on time.

Credit control

Assisting with routine credit control.

Monitoring outstanding client balances.

Sending agreed payment reminders.

Following up outstanding amounts where required.

Keeping credit control records up to date.

About you

Previous office or administrative experience would be useful, but it is not essential. We are more interested in finding someone with the right attitude and approach.

We are looking for someone who is:
- organised and able to manage a number of different tasks;
- proactive and willing to find the next job rather than always waiting to be asked;
- reliable and conscientious;
- friendly, approachable and confident speaking to people;
- comfortable communicating with clients by telephone and email;
- accurate and attentive to detail;
- comfortable using computers and learning different systems;
- willing to ask questions when unsure;
- able to handle confidential information appropriately;
- happy working as part of a team; and
- willing to help different areas of the practice when required.

What we're looking for

The right person will enjoy being the person who keeps things organised and makes sure things get done.

There will be a mixture of regular responsibilities and ad-hoc tasks, so we're looking for somebody who can spot what needs doing, take ownership of it and see it through.

Although you will work closely with our accountants and tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams, this is an administration role rather than a training position for an accountancy or tax career.

We want someone who is happy to build their knowledge of how our practice operates and become a reliable source of administrative support across the business.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking to employ a part time Receptionist to join our friendly team. The successful candidate will be required to provide effective and efficient reception and administrative services for the practice in a professional and courteous manner. Experienced in delivering a high standard of customer service is valued but full training for this role will be provided. The role is for 10 permanent hours per week , one of which will be a Friday afternoon shift until 6:45pm . There will also be an additional 16 hours per week to cover maternity leave for 12 months . Please only apply if you are able to commit to these hours and the Friday afternoon shift until 6:45pm. Also there is a need to be able to cover colleagues for sickness and holiday absence. Offer general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice, including the provision clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the practice team Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies Ensure efficient running of appointment system. Be aware of flow of patients into consulting rooms and advise patients regarding any potential delays. Help coordinate urgent on the day appointments for patients either by assisting with the online forms or walk-in emergencies. Respond to all queries and requests for assistance from patients and other visitors. Participate in Care Navigation, which involves signposting patient to more appropriate health care services. Take and process new patient registrations. Safely take samples from patients as per the Sample Handing protocol. Take subject access requests from patients. Set up online user accounts. Ensure that you are familiar with the appointment systems being used for the practice and Primary Care Network appointments. Book appointments for long term condition recalls as per the patients needs. Process patient information such as notifications of deaths as per practice protocols. Receive and transfer telephone calls. Ensure accurate messages are transcribed to the relevant recipient. To assist with the Practices clerical work as required. This may involve clinical data entry onto the computer, scanning of documents, issuing mail-merge letters, recording and extracting data for audit purposes. To retrieve and advise patients of their tests results. To provide holiday and sickness cover for colleagues as required. This list is not exhaustive and other duties relative to the role may apply.
